title: Cybench: A Framework for Evaluating Cybersecurity Capabilities and Risks of Language Models
paper_type_zh: ICLR 2025 Oral / arXiv 的 benchmark / evaluation surface
best_for_zh: 关注 benchmark、评分契约、污染风险、评测 harness 和后训练反馈可复用性的研究者。
one_line: Cybench exposes CTF/cyber tasks with flags, subtasks, and command execution as an auditable evaluation surface.
Cybench 把带 flag、子任务与命令执行的夺旗与网络安全任务做成可审计的评测面。
why: Concrete executable security reasoning surface with human difficulty calibration.
inclusion_reason: Concrete executable security reasoning surface with human difficulty calibration.

title: Problem
问题
html: Cybench asks how well language-model agents can solve professional-level cybersecurity capture-the-flag tasks in an executable environment, and what risks those capabilities imply. The primary sources are the arXiv paper, OpenReview ICLR 2025 Oral record, project page, and public GitHub repository. It is in scope as an agent-environment benchmark with programmatic terminal feedback. It is not a static multiple-choice cyber quiz or a pure code benchmark. A task includes a CTF description, starter files, an initialized command environment, optional subtasks, agent actions, observations, and a flag-based success condition. The atlas value is its concrete environment state/action/feedback loop for high-stakes tool-using agents.

Cybench 关注语言模型智能体能否在可执行环境中解决专业级网络安全 CTF 任务，以及这种能力带来的风险。主要来源是 arXiv 论文、ICLR 2025 Oral 的 OpenReview 记录、项目页和公开 GitHub 仓库。它属于 agent-environment benchmark，因为反馈来自命令环境和 flag 验收；它不是静态选择题式网络安全问答，也不是纯代码题。一个任务包含 CTF 描述、starter files、初始化的命令环境、可选 subtasks、智能体动作、环境观察和 flag 成功条件。对 atlas 的价值是提供高风险工具型智能体的状态/动作/反馈闭环。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The contribution is a framework and benchmark of forty recent professional CTF tasks from four competitions, each packaged so an LM agent can execute commands and submit flags. The core mechanism is to wrap real cyber tasks in reproducible environments and add subtasks to expose partial progress when full solves are rare. The data object is an executable CTF episode, not a natural-language answer. The feedback contract is environmental: command outputs provide observations, subtasks diagnose progress, and final success requires the correct flag. Closest comparisons include CyberSecEval-style static evaluations and general agent benchmarks; Cybench stresses real exploitation workflows. Direction label: executable cybersecurity agent benchmark.

核心贡献是一套框架和 40 个近期专业 CTF 任务组成的 benchmark，任务来自四个竞赛，并被封装成语言模型智能体可执行命令、观察输出、提交 flag 的环境。核心机制是把真实网络安全任务包装成可复现环境，同时加入 subtasks，用于在完整解题很少时诊断部分进展。数据对象是可执行 CTF episode，不是自然语言答案。反馈契约是环境式的：命令输出给观察，subtask 给进度诊断，最终成功由正确 flag 决定。最近对比包括 CyberSecEval 式静态评测和通用 agent benchmark；Cybench 更强调真实利用流程。方向标签是可执行网络安全智能体 benchmark。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Inputs: CTF task descriptions, starter files, challenge environments, optional subtask definitions, and an agent scaffold.
  2. Episode loop: the agent receives the task, issues shell or scaffold-specific actions, observes command outputs, and iterates until timeout, budget exhaustion, or flag submission.
  3. Subtask evaluation: intermediate checks mark progress on steps that may be easier than a full solve.
  4. Outputs: final flag success/failure, subtask completion, action transcript, command outputs, and model/scaffold metadata.
  5. Feedback contract: terminal commands and challenge services provide observations; the final predicate is flag correctness under the Cybench evaluator.
  6. Reproducibility notes: pin Docker/container images, task version, scaffold, model version, search access policy, budget, timeout, flag leakage fixes, and leaderboard date.

1. 输入：CTF 任务说明、starter files、挑战环境、可选 subtask 定义和 agent scaffold。
  2. episode 循环：智能体读取任务，发出 shell 或 scaffold 专用动作，观察命令输出，并在 timeout、预算耗尽或提交 flag 前持续迭代。
  3. subtask 评测：中间检查记录部分步骤是否完成，用于诊断完整解题失败时的进展。
  4. 输出：最终 flag 成功/失败、subtask 完成情况、动作轨迹、命令输出和模型/scaffold 元数据。
  5. 反馈契约：终端命令与挑战服务提供观察；终止谓词是 Cybench evaluator 下的 flag 正确性。
  6. 复现边界：需固定 Docker/container 镜像、任务版本、scaffold、模型版本、搜索访问策略、预算、timeout、flag 泄漏修复和榜单日期。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The paper reports forty professional-level CTF tasks from four competitions and evaluates eight models, with additional scaffold comparisons for top models. It reports that agents using Claude 3.5 Sonnet, GPT-4o, OpenAI o1-preview, and Claude 3 Opus solve some complete tasks without subtask guidance, while the hardest human-calibrated task took teams 24 hours and 54 minutes. The decisive row-level evidence is a valid flag or subtask check produced inside the challenge environment. The evidence boundary is narrow: success depends on scaffold, command environment, web-search policy, budget, and any answer-leak fixes; partial subtask progress must not be reported as full task success.

论文报告 benchmark 含 40 个专业级 CTF 任务，来自四个竞赛，并评测 8 个模型；对表现较好的模型还比较多个 scaffold。作者报告 Claude 3.5 Sonnet、GPT-4o、OpenAI o1-preview 和 Claude 3 Opus 驱动的 agent 在没有 subtask guidance 时能解决部分完整任务，而人类校准中最难任务耗时 24 小时 54 分钟。逐实例决定性证据是挑战环境中产生的有效 flag 或 subtask check。证据边界很窄：成功率受 scaffold、命令环境、web search 策略、预算和 answer-leak 修复影响；subtask 进度不能当作完整任务成功。

title: Novelty
新意
html: The prior baseline is either static cyber knowledge testing or broad agent benchmarks with low cyber specificity. Cybench changes the object to executable CTF episodes with real files, services, command outputs, and flags. It also adds subtasks so partial capability can be audited instead of only reporting zero-one full solves. The direction signal is a high-risk evaluation surface where agent autonomy, tool use, and environment feedback are inseparable. The quality signal is recent professional tasks plus human difficulty calibration. What is not new: CTF flags, shell environments, and agent scaffolds already existed. Reuse requires checking competition data rights, Docker images, network policy, hidden-answer leakage, safety controls, and whether public tasks have entered training corpora.

已有基线要么是静态网络安全知识测试，要么是网络安全特异性较弱的通用 agent benchmark。Cybench 把对象改成可执行 CTF episode，包含真实文件、服务、命令输出和 flag。它还加入 subtasks，让研究者能审计部分能力，而不只看完整解题的零一结果。方向信号是一个高风险评测面：agent autonomy、工具使用和环境反馈不可分开。质量信号是近期专业任务和人类难度校准。并不新的部分是 CTF flag、shell 环境和 agent scaffold。复用前要审计竞赛数据权利、Docker 镜像、网络策略、答案泄漏、安全控制和公开任务污染。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Correctness is relative to the packaged challenge and evaluator, not to general cybersecurity competence. A flag proves that the agent completed that instance under a specific scaffold and budget; it does not prove robust penetration-testing ability. Task services, containers, and dependencies can drift. Web access and prompt scaffolds can change the capability being measured. Public CTF tasks can leak into model training, and official repositories may patch answer leakage or update tasks. Safety interpretation must be careful: capability measurement is not a deployment recommendation, and subtask success may still represent sensitive offensive knowledge.

正确性只相对于被封装的挑战和 evaluator 成立，不等于通用网络安全能力。一个 flag 只能证明智能体在特定 scaffold、预算和环境下完成该实例，不能证明稳健渗透测试能力。任务服务、容器和依赖可能漂移。web access 与 prompt scaffold 会改变被测能力。公开 CTF 任务可能进入模型训练，官方仓库也可能修补答案泄漏或更新任务。安全解释要谨慎：能力测量不是部署建议，subtask 成功也可能代表敏感攻击知识。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use Cybench as a template for executable agent benchmarks where the environment, action transcript, and terminal predicate are all first-class fields. Preserve task ID, competition/source, files, container image, scaffold, model, web/search policy, command transcript, observations, budget, subtask checks, final flag result, and safety notes. For atlas curation, it is useful as an example of full-episode supervision with both sparse final reward and denser diagnostic checks. It can also guide audits of whether a proposed cyber-agent score reflects real environment interaction or only static knowledge.

Cybench 可作为可执行 agent benchmark 的模板，其中环境、动作轨迹和终止谓词都是一等字段。复用时应保留 task ID、竞赛/来源、文件、container image、scaffold、模型、web/search 策略、命令轨迹、观察、预算、subtask checks、最终 flag 结果和安全说明。对 atlas 来说，它是 full-episode supervision 的例子，同时有稀疏最终奖励和较密的诊断检查。它也能帮助审计某个 cyber-agent 分数到底来自真实环境交互，还是只来自静态知识。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the task packaging and scaffold settings before the headline solve rates. Keep final flag success, subtask completion, and human difficulty separate. A model that solves an easy CTF task under one scaffold has not necessarily acquired general cyber autonomy. Also separate capability measurement from safety claims: the same environment is useful for benchmarking and for risk assessment, but those claims have different evidence thresholds.
看 headline solve rate 前，应先读任务封装和 scaffold 设置。最终 flag 成功、subtask 完成和人类难度要分开。模型在某个 scaffold 下解决一个较易 CTF 任务，不等于具备通用网络安全自主能力。还要区分能力测量和安全结论：同一环境可用于 benchmark 和风险评估，但两类 claim 的证据门槛不同。
